window_independence: Separate tools/thor.py invocations and fresh model processes for window0 and window1
calibration: 4 official A/A pairs each process window; abs median signed drift <=3%
order: Adjacent AB/BA by (window_index + pair_index) % 2; every row retained
warmup: 2 complete untimed requests per mode and measured shape
condition: Cold UND: clear runner and condition cache before every timed request; different positive/negative CFG contents
quality: finite BF16 output, correct shape and raw BF16 bytes exactly equal to fresh independent official oracle
boundary: GPU pixels -> online VAE -> original engine.step -> UND -> 8 GEN -> action head -> ready GPU action sync
primary_statistic: median over pair-wise 100*(1-candidate_ms/official_ms), separately per window and per case
synthetic_fixture_limitation: Varied deterministic token IDs and pixels; no language or robot rollout quality claim
